answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Business Question ID: 3387 Country: India Title: I would like to sell Dogs for security purposes. Companies and people would buy them for their home security. Please let me know whether i can start the business of raising dogs and selling them for only security purpose and not as pets. Question: Salam, I would like to sell Dogs for security purposes. Companies and people would buy them for their home security. Please let me know whether i can start the business of raising dogs and selling them for only security purpose and not as pets. Regards, Noor Answer ID: 3387 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 429/B=61/TB) Though its selling is allowed but it is undesirable: و صح بیع الکلب ولو عقوراً ( الشامی: 7/478 ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
